status: TEST-FIRST extension of an isolated AVX2 experiment; not a production optimization or performance qualification
observed_coverage_gaps: The stock source_factory_benchmark ScopedDenormals enables FTZ and DAZ (0x8040). Existing tryTickFour correctly declines those unqualified modes, so it cannot accelerate that workload.

The original independent-lane FP matrix has width 4 but presents (pos*3+sample)%16. Its active indices 0..3 can never form four consecutive presented lanes; therefore the original aggregate admission count does not establish vector execution in those matrix cells. This is a coverage limitation, not a demonstrated numerical error.
unchanged_gates: Preserve all original 96 cases on x86 with four denormal modes, frozen full-state/output/event/FP comparisons, masked lanes, physical boundary/control changes, copy/reset/restore/idle/wake coverage and the x87 trap guard witness. Preserve every original production, Legacy, V1/V2, alias, click, circuit and CPU threshold.

new_matrix.denormal_modes: All supported hardware FTZ/DAZ combinations, detected by the unchanged original oracle
new_matrix.presentation_and_events: Unchanged oneCase rotating stride-3 schedule, independent masks, controls, original frozen scalar lane order and every-sample full-state comparison
new_matrix.work_gate_per_cell: At least 100 actual tryTickFour admission attempts in every rate/round/denormal cell; at least 100 admitted calls per nearest-round cell; exactly zero admissions for every other rounding-mode cell. Print all cell counts; aggregates cannot substitute.
new_matrix.fp_gate: Every admitted batch matches frozen scalar caller-exit x87/SSE state and every rejected batch leaves all caller FP status/control untouched. The attempted optimization may broaden only nearest/masked-trap FTZ/DAZ support; no caller mode changes and no rounding/trap guard removal.
new_matrix.stored_denormal_probe: Only added full-width cases seed all residual rings at sample 101 with bit-exact signed minimum/maximum subnormal and signed-zero payloads. Restore invalidates caches; require at least one admitted batch whose current residualCursor consumes a nonzero subnormal residual in every nearest-mode rate/denormal cell. Frozen state and caller-exit FP equality remain mandatory.

red_first: Run the new matrix against the untouched parent backend and retain ordinary exit 1 at WSC denormal-mode actual-admission work gate failed. Existing modes remain exact. Preserve this result before modifying any backend admission guard.
negative_controls: Reinstate original FTZ/DAZ rejection or force false admission: ordinary exit 1 at the per-cell work gate.

Return true without physical vector/state work: ordinary exact output/state failure; inspect compiled AVX double arithmetic rather than accepting an admission counter as proof of useful vector computation.
Remove the existing x87 masked-trap guard: unchanged x87 negative witness must exit 1.
Preserve and rerun original MASK, CROSS_LANE, EVENT and FP oracle mutants.
production_admission: No Engine call or production enablement in this step. Any later combined Engine integration needs distinct actual WSC/HP/LP vector work witnesses, complete scheduling/RNG/mix and strict Legacy/V1/V2 oracles, then original 51-row same-host three-before/three-after qualification. Held <=0.20 RTF and quiet idle <=0.02 remain mandatory; this extension alone makes no speedup or completion claim.
